search_window.basis: Most recent verified preceding Food Line watch heartbeat, completed 2026-10-30 19:51:55.741 PDT, through this run; 2026-10-30 Pacific observation date. Search recency exceeds window to allow for indexing lag, but only new qualifying developments count.

coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary source recall; Food Line production nationwide collector is authoritative. No editorial review, approvals, publication, or schedule/task alterations.

Twelve targeted fast web searches completed in two batches (6+6), without tool-level search failures; coverage: sole/last/full-service grocer closure/disaster (4); canceled storm/disaster emergency distributions and abrupt food-bank/pantry loss (5); official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions with immediate impact (3).

No newly published, verified, qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified in the bounded interval. Search results were dominated by older grocery closures, prior hurricanes, generic pages, or unrelated assistance-policy notices; this is not proof of absence of local unindexed events.

September 15, 2026 Aurora, North Carolina Goodwill Community Cupboard reopening excluded: improved grocery access, not a new loss. https://wcti12.com/news/local/goodwill-community-cupboard-opens-in-aurora-ending-years-long-food-desert
August 13, 2026 North Charleston Save A Lot closure excluded: historical outside interval. https://www.live5news.com/2026/08/13/save-lot-closure-expands-north-charleston-neighborhoods-food-desert/
